text:
alex: Customer report — tool call always 400 on our docs-runner tool. payload looks fine in their UI but API rejects. They pasted this payload:

alex: ```
{
  'instruction': 'Run the job with config:
line1
line2',
  'options': {
    'timeout': 30,
  },
}
```

support_jordan: Ah — single quotes + trailing comma. API expects strict JSON (double quotes, no trailing comma). Can you ask for the raw request body + Content-Type header from the customer?

alex: They sent a curl from a Windows electron client, claim they just copy/paste from the app. Header shows `Content-Type: application/json`. Raw body contains CRLFs and unescaped newlines.

priya: This looks like the client SDK v0.9.2 bug where stringify() sometimes produces single quotes for multiline strings when run in the electron renderer. We patched it in 0.9.3. Repro steps: use the same input, call sdk.serialize(payload) in renderer context.

support_jordan: Can you repro locally and get a minimal curl I can forward to backend? If it's a client bug we should provide quick mitigation for support: replace single quotes with double quotes and remove trailing commas before send.

priya: Repro snippet (from my local repro):
```bash
# bad (what electron client sent)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{ 'instruction': 'line1
line2', 'options': { 'timeout': 30, }, }"

# good (fixed)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"instruction":"line1\nline2","options":{"timeout":30}}'
```

alex: Customer asked for a hotfix — they're blocked in staging. Can we suggest a server-side tolerant parse as a band-aid?

priya: We should avoid permissive parsing for security reasons, but a targeted pre-parse that normalizes CRLF -> \n and converts smart quotes / single quotes when the Content-Type is application/json could be acceptable for a short window. I'll open a patch: add a strict sanitizer behind a feature flag for support teams to enable per-customer.

incidents-bot: Incident created #INC-2026 — tag: support, eng-runtime.

support_jordan: For the short-term, send customer these steps: 1) update SDK to 0.9.3, 2) ensure payloads are JSON.stringify()d in main process, or 3) run this quick node sanitization before sending:
```js
function quickSanitize(s){
  return s.replace(/\u2018|\u2019|\u201C|\u201D/g,'\"')
          .replace(/,\s*}/g,'}')
          .replace(/,\s*]/g,']')
          .replace(/\r\n|\r/g,'\\n');
}
```

alex: I'll pass that along and ask for the raw request if they still see a 400. Thanks — will update thread after customer tests. :thumbsup:
